question: In 2024, India hosted its first and largest multinational air combat exercise, marking a significant milestone in its defence diplomacy. What was the name of this exercise?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Exercise Tarang Shakti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise Tarang Shakti** was India's first and largest **multinational air combat exercise** hosted in **2024**.
 
• This exercise marked a major milestone in India's **defence diplomacy** by involving participation from multiple nations.
 
• The primary aim of this exercise was to strengthen **strategic partnerships** and promote **interoperability** among the participating air forces.
 
• It showcased India's capability to host large-scale **military exercises** and its growing prominence in the global defence arena.
 
• The exercise focused on advanced **air combat techniques**, operational strategies, and the sharing of technical expertise among participating nations.
 
• The event highlighted India's commitment to fostering **regional security** and promoting global peace through collaborative defence initiatives.
 
• The name "Tarang Shakti" signifies **strength and synergy**, symbolizing India's vision for enhanced cooperation and mutual trust among its defence partners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Exercise Vayu Shakti**__

 __
 
• **Exercise Vayu Shakti** is an air power demonstration conducted by the **Indian Air Force (IAF)** at the Pokhran range.
 
• This exercise showcases the **IAF's operational capabilities** and includes live demonstrations of aerial combat, bombing, and other air power techniques.
 
• Unlike Tarang Shakti, it is not a multinational exercise but focuses on India's internal air defence capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Exercise Shakti**__
 __
 
• **Exercise Shakti** is a biennial military exercise between **India and France**, focusing on **counter-terrorism operations** and joint military drills.
 
• This exercise primarily involves the **Indian Army** and the French Army, rather than air forces.
 
 
 
• **Exercise Yudh Abhyas**__
 
 
• **Exercise Yudh Abhyas** is an annual bilateral military exercise conducted between **India and the United States.**
 
• It focuses on enhancing **interoperability** and joint operational capabilities between the armies of both nations.
 
• This exercise does not involve air combat but emphasizes **land-based operations** and tactical drills.
